doc.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Family life with young sons
summary: Carter talks about his sons' births, Janet's role, and bringing the children dinner at 3:30 AM.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well, aside from it being new era music, whatever that meant at the time, it was also an era of family life because I figure it was right around the time your first son was born.
Did that change your musical life in any way?
Did you have any particular challenges in balancing family and music?

Um … Janet probably did. I'd come home from work at night at 2 o'clock in the morning and I would stop by a restaurant and get something to eat and wake up the kids and say, Let's have something to eat. That's not a good idea at 3:30 AM, I guess. (laughs)
Okay. And of course Miles was born just three years later.
